description: Born Ashley Elizabeth Hinson; father a financial adviser, mother a teacher.
Studied broadcast journalism; Pi Beta Phi alumna.
More than a decade at KCRG; won two regional Emmy Awards.

role_or_event: Elected to the Iowa House, District 67

description: Defeated teacher Eric Gjerde 52%-48%; chaired the Judiciary, Public Safety and Transportation committees.
Filed to challenge first-term Democrat Abby Finkenauer.
Won the primary; the general election followed in November.

role_or_event: Elected to the U.S. House, IA-01
description: Beat Finkenauer 51.2%-48.6%; tied with Mariannette Miller-Meeks as the first Republican woman to represent Iowa in the House.
Represented Iowa's 1st district through the 117th Congress.
After redistricting moved her home in Marion into the 2nd district, she sought and won re-election there.
Announced on WHO Radio's Simon Conway show hours after Joni Ernst's retirement video.
74% to 26% over former state Sen. Jim Carlin.
